reason: A read-only Settings interface for browsing installed skills, searching their metadata, and moving the Skills entry between the sidebar and Plugins tab; navigation-panels is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 在设置界面以只读目录浏览、搜索并管理已安装技能入口，可在侧边栏与插件标签页之间移动。
summaries.en: Browse and search installed skills in a read-only Settings catalog, with an option to move the Skills entry between the sidebar and Plugins tab.

capabilities: Scans configured user skill roots and parses skill metadata
Provides a same-origin API for a read-only skill catalog
Adds a Skills entry to Settings and can move it between the sidebar and Plugins tab
Persists the selected placement in localStorage
